**Finding: compliant (no redline proposed).**

RadialSpark has no audit, inspection, verification or usage-review right against Clear Capital anywhere in the agreement. Billing verification is handled by Contractor's own invoices with supporting detail (§ 3(b)), and the only system-access language runs in our favour (§ 1(c) requires Contractor personnel to comply with Company security and computer-access policies). Since there is no Vendor audit right in existence, the AUDIT limits (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, independent confidential auditor, off-site, cost-shifting at 5%, no system access) have nothing to attach to, and the absence is better for us than either the preferred or fallback position — so we deliberately do not insert audit machinery running against ourselves.
